checks.label: PAM valid for the nuclease
checks.message: The PAM CGG sits 3' of the spacer at target positions 88 to 91 and satisfies the SpCas9 motif NGG. No change needed.
checks.threshold: NGG 3' of the spacer, spacer 20 nt
checks.citation: Appendix C of the engine capability system design (configurable feature windows)

checks.label: Spacer length correct for the nuclease
checks.message: The spacer is 20 nt, which is the SpCas9 spacer length. No change needed.
checks.threshold: 20 nt
checks.citation: Appendix C of the engine capability system design (configurable feature windows)

checks.label: Spacer GC fraction in window
checks.message: Spacer GC fraction is 0.50, inside the configured window 0.40 to 0.70. No change needed.
checks.citation: Appendix C of the engine capability system design (configurable feature windows)

checks.label: No U6 terminator motif in spacer
checks.message: The spacer does not contain TTTT, so U6 transcription will not terminate inside the guide. No change needed.
checks.threshold: TTTT must not appear in the spacer
checks.citation: Appendix C of the engine capability system design (configurable feature windows)

checks.label: No long homopolymer run in spacer
checks.message: The longest homopolymer run in the spacer is within the configured maximum of 4. No change needed.
checks.threshold: at most 4 identical bases in a row
checks.citation: Appendix C of the engine capability system design (configurable feature windows)

checks.label: No disruptive internal self-complementarity
checks.message: The longest internal self-complementary stem in the spacer is 3 bp, under the configured reporting length of 7 bp. No change needed.
checks.threshold: longest internal stem under 7 bp, with a loop of at least 3 nt (Construct convention, not a published value; see the docstring in constants.py)
checks.citation: Section 8.5 of the engine capability system design (sequence feature checks)

checks.label: Cut site positioned for a knockout
checks.message: The cut site is at target position 85, but no cds_region was supplied, so whether it falls in an early constitutive region cannot be evaluated. Supply cds_region, and final_exon_region and constitutive_regions if known, to evaluate this check.
checks.threshold: cut site inside the coding sequence, within the first 60% of it, outside the final exon, in a constitutive region (fraction is a Construct convention, not a published value; see the docstring in constants.py; the final exon and constitutive rules are Section 8.5 of the engine capability system design (sequence feature checks))
checks.citation: Section 8.5 of the engine capability system design (sequence feature checks)

checks.label: Guide does not target the delivery construct
checks.message: No delivery construct sequence was supplied, so whether this guide cuts its own delivery vector cannot be evaluated. Supply delivery_construct_sequence (and delivery_construct_name) to evaluate this check. A guide that cuts its own vector destroys the vector in the transfected cell.
checks.threshold: no NGG PAM adjacent to a copy of the spacer in the delivery construct, within 4 mismatches
checks.citation: Section 8.5 of the engine capability system design (sequence feature checks)

checks.label: Spacer free of the cloning enzyme site
checks.message: The spacer contains no BbsI site (GAAGAC) on either strand, so it survives the digest used to clone into pX330-U6-Chimeric_BB-CBh-hSpCas9 and derivatives (Addgene 42230). No change needed.
checks.threshold: BbsI site GAAGAC must not appear in the spacer, on either strand
checks.citation: Appendix D of the engine capability system design (Type IIS enzyme reference)

checks.label: Off-target sites in the searched space
checks.message: Off-target search covered the target sequence only, 198 bp in total across 1 sequence. No delivery construct sequence was supplied, so self-targeting of the delivery construct was not searched. This is not a genome-wide search. No other site in it matches this spacer within 4 mismatches next to a valid PAM. No change needed inside this space. Sites outside it were not examined.
checks.threshold: no site within 2 mismatches carrying at most 0 seed mismatch(es); searched to 4 mismatches; seed is positions 9 to 20 (the PAM-proximal 12 nt)
checks.citation: Section 8.6 of the engine capability system design (off-target search, scoped honestly)
